backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the HKLO blog backend; defines Post/UserProfile types, manages posts with CRUD operations, handles owner/admin role management via AccessControl, and includes blob storage via mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features: canvas-based image compression (max 1200px, JPEG 0.6, 800 KB limit) in useImageUpload.ts, and a clipboard share button with Swedish toast in PostCard.tsx and PostDetailPage.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source files to one-sentence summaries describing each file's role and recent changes, serving as a reference document for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell with Swedish language attribute, HKLO title, and a root div that mounts the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router route tree; post detail route is publicly accessible while home, create, edit, and admin routes are wrapped in ProtectedRoute.
frontend/src/components/admin/AllPostsSe: Admin table view listing all posts with options to edit, delete, and change post status (published/draft/hidden), using mutation hooks and toast notifications for feedback.
frontend/src/components/admin/ManageAdmi: Admin panel section for viewing, adding, and removing admin principals by Internet Identity principal ID, with confirmation dialogs and error handling.
frontend/src/components/admin/ManageAuth: Admin panel section that lists all authors in a table and allows removing an author (along with their posts) via a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/admin/PostEditMo: Modal dialog for admins to edit an existing post's title, content, author, status, and images, supporting both existing image management and new image uploads.
frontend/src/components/ImageGallery.tsx: Renders a responsive grid of images from Uint8Array data by creating and revoking blob URLs via a ref, with loading state and fallback placeholders for broken or empty images.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App shell with sticky header, footer, and navigation that shows full nav links to authenticated users and a login button to unauthenticated visitors.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Renders a blog post card with thumbnail image (converted from binary blob), title, author, date, content preview, and a share button that copies the post URL to clipboard.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Wraps child routes to require Internet Identity authentication, redirecting unauthenticated or anonymous users to the login page while showing a loading spinner during initialization.
frontend/src/config/constants.ts: Exports a single constant containing the hardcoded admin principal ID string.
frontend/src/data/titleSuggestions.ts: Defines a set of Swedish blog post title suggestions organized by category (Livsstil, Livsberättelser, Mat, Hobby, Djupa tankar) and exports the category list.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated identities, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useImageUpload.ts: Custom hook for managing image file uploads with client-side validation, compression/resizing via Canvas API, and preview URL generation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting posts, as well as admin and author management operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines a warm editorial CSS custom property palette for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status and renders tabbed sections for managing posts, admins, and authors, with loading and access-denied states.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component with a form for creating new blog posts, supporting title suggestions by category, image uploads, publish toggle, and field validation.
frontend/src/pages/EditPostPage.tsx: Page component for editing an existing blog post, including form fields for title, content, author, category, publish status, and image management. Validates ownership via Internet Identity before allowing edits.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page that fetches and displays all published posts sorted by creation date using PostCard components, with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page that authenticates users via Internet Identity, redirecting already-authenticated users to home and providing a link to create a new Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a single blog post showing full content, images, and owner-only edit/delete actions, with a login gate for unauthenticated users and share-link functionality.
frontend/src/utils/contentTruncator.ts: Utility function that truncates blog post content to a maximum word count while preserving sentence boundaries.
frontend/src/utils/dateFormatter.ts: Utility function that converts a nanosecond-precision backend Time value to a Swedish locale date string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended typography/serif fonts, border radius variables, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state, architecture, known issues, existing features, and pending feature requests for the HKLO blog platform built on Internet Computer with Motoko and React. Version 3, focused on fixing image upload failures and share functionality.
